title: Figful
description: Overlay for foraging in Hypixel Skyblock, made to improve the visibility of trees and general QoL sounds.
body:
**Figful Overlay**
A Hypixel Skyblock Resource Pack created to improve QoL whilst foraging.

Current Features: Recoloured Trees, Custom Break + Tree Completed sound

TBA (No Particular Order): 
- Catharsis Support (Allowing toggles and zone control) 
- Better Experience Gained sound
- Monochrome Island


Honestly I don't have too much to write here yet, but this is a work in progress; any ideas I have I will add.
